[[File:Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:Beyond Ruby and Sapphire.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on November 19, 2014 and in New Zealand on December 10, 2014. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire Region Collector's Edition''' in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 23 discs with 191 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5782. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning. It contains all of the episodes from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''. Specifically, it has episodes from ''[[S06|Advanced]]'', ''[[S07|Advanced Challenge]]'', ''[[S08|Advanced Battle]]'', and ''[[S09|Battle Frontier]]''. ==Contents== ===Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Part 1=== [[File:Ruby and Sapphire Part 1.png|thumb|Part 1]] Part 1 contains 40 episodes across 5 discs. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Hoenn}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Hoenn}}" !
